fallback_source_results.note: Ten Hebrew candidate pages returned HTTP 429 and their search snippets were excluded. Eight distinct English publisher bodies were opened and inspected as same-run fallback. Their original-language texts were not collated; all eight are non-independent derived presentations.

method: Manual public web/search/open inspection of eight English-language Yechidus presentations in the Chabad.org Sichos in English Collection, plus one in-place enrichment of an existing Hebrew unedited Sicha transcript. Search snippets for blocked candidates were not used as content evidence.
limitations: All eight new items are English publisher presentations; the original-language texts, recordings and source transcripts were not inspected, so all remain non-independent.

The eight presentations concern eight distinct dates/events; each has a separate provisional Evidence Family. Any later original-language witness for the same event must be linked to that family, not counted as a new event.
Only the cited body passages were inspected; context is partial and no item was promoted to Verified.
AID 2504381's page title gives 25 Tishrei but does not state the year; no year was inferred.

The existing AID 4304431 enrichment describes a teaching attributed within the talk to the Rebbe Rashab as transmitted by the Rebbe Rayatz; it is not represented as an original teaching of the current speaker.
Ten Hebrew candidate pages returned HTTP 429. No crawler retry, access-control bypass or full-text copying was performed.

retrieval_synthesis.selection_rule: Eight distinct Yechidus event Evidence Families are selected by exact AID; each is a non-independent English publisher presentation with one inspected proposition and one body locator.

retrieval_synthesis.researcher_mode: Deep mode exposes all eight non-independent presentations, separate event Evidence Families, partial-context boundaries and a claim_source_map with one inspected locator per claim.
retrieval_synthesis.validation: The validated wrapper requires eight distinct Evidence Families, eight supported propositions, eight claim-local locators, zero independent-witness credit and an explicit system-synthesis attribution.
